Container.Name: fiefdom
Container.Overview:
An isometric castle-builder in the spirit of Stronghold Crusader, played in the browser. Build a settlement in the desert, run the food, ale and weapon chains, raise a garrison and hold your ground against an enemy lord who builds his own economy under the same rules you do.
⚙ Nothing to configure: no database, no API keys, no accounts. Set the port, keep the Saves path on appdata, start it, open the WebUI.
💾 Saved games and custom maps are stored on the server under /data — map it to appdata and they survive updates and are the same in every browser. (Leave it unmapped and the game falls back to per-browser storage.)
Runs entirely client-side: the container only serves static files and a few kilobytes of saves, so it uses almost no CPU or memory on the server. A WebGL-capable browser is required.
Container.Description: An isometric castle-builder in the spirit of Stronghold Crusader, played in the browser. No database, no API keys, no accounts — set a port and play. Saved games and custom maps are stored on the server under /data, so they survive updates. Every sprite in the game is procedurally generated in Blender.
Container.Requires: Nothing. A browser with WebGL support is all that is needed on the client side.
